fees.text: Synchron Advice Pty Ltd and its representatives may receive payments, benefits and commission for the services provided to you as shown below.

Our remuneration schedule may show that we are paid an upfront and ongoing commission by insurance providers. We have chosen this method of remuneration so that you do not have to pay us directly for our insurance advice and services. If you cancel or make changes to your insurance policy/ies within the first two years, we may be required to pay back all or some commission.
The insurance commission we will receive from the insurance provider in connection with these policy(ies) once they are in force is shown below.

Insurance commission is calculated as a percentage of part of your annualised policy cost (being the base premium, which is the premium you pay, less any stamp duty and policy fee). The actual commission amount paid will vary in line with any changes to the premium amount and may be lower than the rate disclosed.

Once the policy becomes active, insurance commission will be paid to Synchron Advice Pty Ltd by the insurer at the percentage rate and frequency shown above. This is included in the insurance premium you pay and is not an additional cost to you. Initial commission is paid for the first year the policy is in force, and ongoing commission is paid for each subsequent year until the policy ceases or we are removed as the servicing adviser, at which point the new servicing licensee or representative may continue to receive the ongoing commission.
